console.title: Launch from the console
console.intro: This is the same thing as the links above: both launch the game with the same parameters, and the game behaves identically. The links only save you the steps below. Use this when nothing happens after you click a link.
steps: In Dota 2 settings, search for "console" and tick Enable Console
In the hotkey settings, bind a key to Console
Back at the Dota 2 main menu, press that key to open the console
Pick the difficulty you want and enter one of the commands below in the console

homeCard.title: Start the game from this site
homeCard.online: Started from this site, the game reaches the server and reads your latest data, so your attribute points and awakenings apply in your next game. Open this to see how.
homeCard.offline: Launched from the Arcade the game cannot reach the server; it reads the data as of the last map update, so your changes wait for it.

notice.property: Launched from the Arcade, attribute points take effect in-game at the next map update. Start the game from this site and they apply in your next game.
notice.awaken: Launched from the Arcade, awakenings take effect in-game at the next map update. Start the game from this site and they apply in your next game.

compare.title: The two ways to start
compare.lead: Whether the game can read your latest data depends on how you start it.
compare.leadOffline: <name>Launched from the Arcade</name>: since Dota 2 7.41f this cannot reach the server, so the game reads the data as of the last map update. That is offline mode.
compare.leadOnline: <name>Started from this site</name>: it reaches the server and reads your latest data, so that is online mode. The trade-off is that you can only play solo.
compare.noteModes: Membership, attribute points and hero awakenings apply either way; launched from the Arcade the game uses the data as of the last map update.
compare.noteTiming: The map updates two to three times a week. Attribute points, awakenings and other changes you make here are picked up at the next map update when you launch from the Arcade, and in your next game when you start from this site.

website.title: Attributes and awakenings happen on this site only
website.body: To keep player data safe, spending attribute points, resetting them and awakening heroes happen on this site only; the in-game buttons for attributes and awakening open this site. The game picks the changes up either way, and only differs in how soon.
website.checkIn: The daily check-in can be claimed here, and starting the game from this site claims it automatically.

membership.title: 10v10AI Premium Membership
membership.description: ⭐Subscribe to get the following benefits (please leave your Dota2 friend ID in the message to auto-activate)
benefits: 💎 Membership points: 1000 points instantly per subscribed month, plus 100 points for each daily check-in, with up to 7 makeup days
🎯 Skill draft upgraded to a pick-1-of-8, with the 2 extra skills more likely to be advanced abilities
🎁 One free reroll for treasure chest item drops
⚔️ Exclusive membership BUFF: +10 attack, +5% spell amplification, +300 HP, +200 MP
🛡️ Respawn time reduced by 5 seconds, buyback cooldown reduced to 2 minutes
🎮 One free reroll each for the starting active and passive skill draft
membership.note: 😊When membership takes effect: start the game from this site and it applies in your next game; launched from the Arcade, it applies at the next map update.

property.title: Attributes
property.intro: Spend attribute points to upgrade your hero. Upgrades are permanent and carry into every game.

points.title: Attribute points
points.formula: Total points = battle level + member level. Each level of either grants 1 point, and neither level ever goes down.

instant.title: Active from hero level 1
instant.hint: No hero level needed — the full value applies as soon as the game starts · {count} attributes

scaling.title: Unlocks as your hero levels
scaling.hint: One level unlocks every 2 hero levels, so these do nothing at hero level 1 · {count} attributes

skill.title: Bonus skill points
skill.hint: Unlocks half as fast as everything else: 1 point every 4 hero levels · {count} attribute

card.effectNote: At level {level}, fully active once your hero reaches level {heroLevel}
card.effectEmpty: Add a level and this will tell you the hero level it needs

reset.title: Reset attributes
reset.description: Clears every level you have added and refunds all attribute points so you can spend them again. Only usable points are charged — total points, lifetime points and your levels stay exactly as they are.
reset.battleShort: You have {have} usable battle points, {need} short.
reset.memberShort: You have {have} usable member points, {need} short.

error.upgrade: The upgrade did not go through — the points may already have been spent elsewhere. The page now shows the latest state; try again.
error.reset: The reset did not go through, probably for want of usable points. The page now shows the latest state.

awaken.title: Hero Awakening
awaken.intro: Unlock a hero’s awakened ability permanently with Battle Points or Member Points.

rules.title: Permanent Awaken
rules.direct: spend 8000 usable Battle Points, or 4000 usable Member Points, to permanently awaken a chosen hero.
rules.random: half price, spend 4000 usable Battle Points, or 2000 usable Member Points, to awaken one of 3 randomly drawn heroes.
rules.note: Only spends usable points: usable points go down, but total points only ever go up and never lower your Battle/Member Level or attribute points. Permanent and irreversible — even if the awakened ability is buffed, nerfed, or reworked later, the hero’s awakening still applies.
